# t32.2 — Zero-exemption Rule 5c and bidirectional ADR-rule guard

**Role:** backend  
**Classification:** brownfield-rewrite  
**Status:** completed

## Summary

The three remaining presentation-owned Micronaut configuration bindings are removed. Effective
review passes, parallelism, stage-model defaults, and reasoning effort now originate in
`ResolveApplicationSettingsPort`, are mapped by `DescribeReviewPlanUseCase`, and cross into
presentation through one `ReviewPlan`. Presentation applies only explicit CLI overrides.

Rule 5c now enforces this boundary over every source-backed presentation primary type with zero
exceptions. `AdrRuleReferenceGuardTest` also keeps Accepted ADR D-item references and executable
primary architecture rules synchronized in both directions, excluding control tests from the
primary inventory.

## Implementation

### Effective settings through the inbound plan port

- Expanded `ReviewPlan` with `defaultParallelism`, review/report/summary model defaults, and the
  reasoning-effort default.
- Expanded `ResolveApplicationSettingsPort`; `ApplicationSettingsAdapter` maps the already
  normalized `ExecutionConfig` and `ModelConfig` values.
- `DescribeReviewPlanUseCase` maps the settings port to the inbound DTO; `ApplicationPortFactory`
  performs the layer-zero binding.
- `ReviewPlan` rejects impossible non-positive or blank/null effective values instead of
  reproducing infrastructure fallback literals.
- `ReviewOptionsParser` seeds parallelism from the plan before applying `--parallelism`.
- `ReviewModelConfigResolver` applies precedence
  `stage-specific CLI > --model > effective plan default`, with explicit reasoning effort over the
  plan default.
- Removed the dead `SkillCommand` timeout field/binding/call argument and the unused
  `SkillExecutionCoordinator.execute` timeout parameter.

### Rule 5c

- Primary rule scans compiled presentation classes for references to
  `io.micronaut.context.annotation` or `io.micronaut.core.bind.annotation`.
- Independent source enumeration proves all 31 presentation primary source types are represented
  in the 72-class compiled subject set.
- The production violation and exemption sets are both empty.
- Permanent test-tree fixture
  `dev.logicojp.reviewer.presentation.T32ConfigurationBindingViolation` proves the analyzer reports
  the exact owner and `io.micronaut.context.annotation.Value` target.

### Bidirectional ADR-rule traceability

- Reads only Accepted `docs/adr/*.md` files.
- Parses each `### Dn.` body through the next level 1–3 heading.
- Extracts canonical `Rule N` / `Rule Nx` references.
- Inventories only `LayerDependencyRulesTest` methods with both `@Test` and a primary display name
  matching `Rule N[x]:` or `Rule N[x] scope:`.
- A `Rule N[x] control:` display name never enters the primary inventory.
- Reports ADR path/D-item/missing rule for ADR-to-test drift and rule/test method for test-to-ADR
  drift.
- Pins `0006/D5 -> Rule 5b`, `0007/D5 -> Rule 4b`, and `0008/D2 -> Rule 8`, and asserts both
  inventories are nonempty.

| Primary Rule 4b renamed while control remained | 2 tests, 2 expected failures | Missing primary Rule 4b plus unreferenced Rule 4x; control did not mask deletion |
| ADR-0007 D5 Rule 4b reference renamed | 2 tests, 2 expected failures | Named `ADR-0007#D5 -> Rule 4x` and missing real D5 anchor |

The last three mutants ran in separate disposable copies under
`/tmp/t322-backend-mutants.XSLNFM`; no source restoration command touched the shared worktree.
